# opnsense_interfaces_neighbor (Resource)

Manages a static OPNsense ARP or NDP neighbour entry.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address.
- `mac_address` (String) Ethernet MAC address.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the neighbour entry.
- `origin` (String) Origin reported by OPNsense.
